question: What is the full timetable in the City of York (Pennsylvania) Pension Funds' November 2016 RFP for an investment manager, adviser or consultant?
gold_answer: RFP issued November 28, 2016; questions due December 12, 2016; responses to questions posted December 16, 2016; proposals due January 6, 2017; interviewees notified February 17, 2017; interviews March 13-17, 2017; selected manager notified May 19, 2017; investment agreement signed June 16, 2017; mandate begins July 1, 2017.
acceptance: Accept equivalent date formatting and March 13–17 as a range. The amendment reservation is optional.
candidate_answer:
The RFP’s full timetable is: ([City of York RFP, p. 3](York_PA__RFP-Investment_Manager_Advisor_Consultant_-_November_2016.pdf))

| Milestone | Date |
|---|---|
| RFP issued | November 28, 2016 |
| Questions about the RFP due | December 12, 2016 |
| Responses to questions posted | December 16, 2016 |
| Proposals due | January 6, 2017 |
| Interviewees notified | February 17, 2017 |
| Interviews | March 13–17, 2017 |
| Selected manager notified | May 19, 2017 |
| Investment agreement signed | June 16, 2017 |
| Mandate begins | July 1, 2017 |

The City reserved the right to amend the timetable.
